title: Easy Chicken Red Thai Curry Meal Box

items: 450g chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tablespoons fish sauce (or soy sauce for a vegetarian option)
Fresh basil or cilantro, for garnish (optional)
Cooked rice or rice noodles, for serving | works great with Quinoa too

method: In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add in the sliced vegetables and cook till done. Take it out of the pan.
Add the chicken pieces to the skillet and cook until they are no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the red Thai curry paste and cook for another 2 minutes, allowing the paste to become fragrant and coat the chicken. Add in the cooked vegetables as well.
Add the coconut milk + water to the skillet, stirring well to combine with the curry paste.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. . Stir occasionally.

Stir in the fish sauce (or soy sauce), brown sugar, and lime juice. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. If you prefer a spicier curry, you can add a bit more curry paste or some chopped red chilies.
Garnish with fresh basil or cilantro if desired. Serve the curry hot over cooked jasmine rice or rice noodles.
Enjoy your flavorful and easy Chicken Red Thai Curry!
caption:
Easy Chicken Red Thai Curry meal box | meal prep | lunch box | 30 minute recipe 
Ingredients:
* 450g chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
* 2 tablespoons red Thai curry paste
* 300 ml coconut milk + 1/2 cup water
* 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
* 1 medium carrot, sliced 
* 1 capsicum, sliced
* 200 grams mushrooms, sliced
* 1 tablespoons fish sauce (or soy sauce for a vegetarian option)
* 1 tablespoon brown sugar
* 1 tablespoon lime juice
* Fresh basil or cilantro, for garnish (optional)
* Cooked rice or rice noodles, for serving | works great with Quinoa too  
Instructions:
In a large skillet or wok, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and add in the sliced vegetables and cook till done. Take it out of the pan. 
Add the chicken pieces to the skillet and cook until they are no longer pink, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the red Thai curry paste and cook for another 2 minutes, allowing the paste to become fragrant and coat the chicken. Add in the cooked vegetables as well.
Add the coconut milk + water to the skillet, stirring well to combine with the curry paste.
Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer. . Stir occasionally.
Stir in the fish sauce (or soy sauce), brown sugar, and lime juice. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. If you prefer a spicier curry, you can add a bit more curry paste or some chopped red chilies.
Garnish with fresh basil or cilantro if desired. Serve the curry hot over cooked jasmine rice or rice noodles.
Enjoy your flavorful and easy Chicken Red Thai Curry!
